column5: GROUP: Checked interpreter (units 110 and 111): | - CI/program_values.rs:845-891: `coerce_scalar_with` and `coerce_scalar_value` return the value unchanged for non-primitive destinations and for `Bool`, `Str`, non-F32 floats. 252-256, 423: unrecognised recast shapes give `Ok(None)`; what the caller does with it was not traced. 2326: a binary expression with one typed side takes that type. 815-837: an unknown member means no coercion.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, host boundary: | - TI/boundary_effects.rs:51-53: input requirements return `Ok` when `scalar_requires` is empty; whether structural requirements are carried elsewhere was not traced. 2025-2027, 1996-1998: "intrinsic" qualifications count as covered (callee not read).

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, host boundary: | - TI/boundary_effects.rs:2304-2306: with no projection table a view path is appended to the referent without validation. 2737-2762: the opaque arm stores the host's `opaque_identity` for any non-materialized structural type; the identity's origin is not checked there.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, host boundary: | - TI/boundary_effects.rs:3276-3296: qualification and restoration checks return `Ok` when the storage has no single owner. Reader's wrong program: a mutable host loan of an owned array element, representation byte or view byte skips the qualification-coverage check. 3418-3422: non-`ScalarField` endpoints get no field restriction on a host replacement. 3339-3394: restoration passes if no live value owns the target.
GROUP: Terminal interpreter, host boundary: | - TI/boundary_effects.rs:3562-3574: `poll_host_computation` and `poll_effect_readiness` default to `Ok(true)`.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, host boundary: | - TI/boundary_inputs.rs:1449, 1606, 1609: a byte-view argument whose path does not resolve to a byte array yields `Ok(None)`. 2357: other leaf kinds are skipped by `_ => {}`. 2416-2417: `overlaps` is `false` for an out-of-range argument index (the other binders reject that index later). 2751-2767: boolean-field presence is not required for case payloads.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, host boundary: | - TI/boundary_storage_inputs.rs:285: direct-original commit records a write the host already made; what the callee checks is unread. 1877, 2130: normal-qualification preservation is skipped for `SharedBorrow` selections, no comment. 1553, 1561: non-reference opaque leaves get no child capture.

GROUP: Terminal interpreter, host boundary: | - TI/boundary_values.rs:175-181 (no checks requested means complete; admission side not traced); 1102-1114 (a row table not in the fixed list would not be charged; inferred); 1402-1404 (a finished type id is skipped without comparing declarations).
